name: Central Slip Injury of the Finger
tags: central slip injury of the finger
definition: Injury of the central slip of the extensor tendon at the PIP joint, which can progress to boutonnière deformity if missed.

investigations.principle: Radiographs exclude avulsion fracture; ultrasound/MRI is selective.
investigations.MRI: Use MRI when neural, soft-tissue, marrow, vascular, occult injury or other condition-specific assessment requires it.
investigations.radiographs: Use radiographs and/or CT according to the condition-specific imaging pathway.

green: Early PIP extension splinting when appropriate
amber: Delayed diagnosis increases risk of fixed boutonnière deformity.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Anguli-Snayu injury phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Injury of the central slip of the extensor tendon at the PIP joint, which can progress to boutonnière deformity if missed.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe vascular symptoms, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, sphincter change or other listed red flags.
